papers.title: Ultrasonic Peening Treatment Used to Improve Stress Corrosion Resistance of AlSi10Mg Components Fabricated Using Selective Laser Melting
papers.abstract: As a rapidly evolving advanced digital manufacturing technology, additive manufacturing (AM) has its advantages including short manufacturing cycle, material saving, and complexity for free. It has great potential for application in marine and offshore engineering. However, stress corrosion damage will be a big threat for the additively manufactured metal parts in the ocean environment due to large residual stresses generated in the building process. This paper focuses on the effect of ultrasonic peening treatment (UPT) on stress corrosion resistance of AlSi10Mg components fabricated using Selective Laser Melting (SLM). Firstly, AlSi10Mg specimens were prepared using an SLM machine, and UPT was conducted on the specimen’s top surface. Then, a series of measurements and analyses were carried out for the specimens before and after the UPT process. The residual stresses and hardness of the specimens were measured, and the surface morphology was observed using a scanning electron microscope (SEM). The resistance of stress corrosion was evaluated by the electrochemical corrosion test. The experimental results show that UPT can significantly improve stress corrosion resistance of SLM-fabricated specimens.

summary_zh.motivation: 海洋环境中SLM金属部件应力腐蚀威胁大，需改善。
summary_zh.method: 对SLM制备的AlSi10Mg试样进行超声冲击处理，测量残余应力、硬度和表面形貌。
summary_zh.result: 超声冲击处理显著提高了试样的抗应力腐蚀性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过电化学腐蚀试验验证抗应力腐蚀性能。

summary_en.motivation: To address stress corrosion damage in additively manufactured metal parts for marine applications by reducing residual stresses.
summary_en.method: Ultrasonic peening treatment was applied to SLM-fabricated AlSi10Mg specimens, followed by residual stress, hardness, and SEM morphology characterization.
summary_en.result: UPT significantly improved stress corrosion resistance as evaluated by electrochemical corrosion tests.
summary_en.validation: Electrochemical corrosion testing was used to assess stress corrosion resistance before and after UPT.

papers.title: Hip Resurfacing Utilizing the Direct Anterior Approach
papers.abstract: Background: The direct anterior approach (DAA) has been used successfully in total hip arthroplasty with many benefits including improved radiographic positioning of components, earlier ambulation, as well as decreased narcotic consumption, length of stay, dislocation rate, discharge to rehabilitation facility (vs. home) and 30-day readmission. Hip resurfacing can be a successful surgical option for the properly selected patient as it can preserve bone stock and provide excellent function including improved activity levels as compared with total hip arthroplasty. Traditionally hip resurfacing has been performed via an extensile posterior approach, but the benefits of DAA can be applied to resurfacing though not without a learning curve. Case Presentation: Here we report the surgical technique of hip resurfacing performed supine on a Hana table via the DAA and include key steps to ensure adequate exposure and minimize complications.

papers.title: LBAC Web
papers.abstract: The e-government puts forward the growing security demands on information system, in this context, thin client based solution appears. The thin client provides similar functions but better security by cloud storage and centralized management as rich client. The main technologies are virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) and Web client by now. Recently the development of Web-based operating system (Web OS) promotes Web client. But these Web OSes mainly aim at mobility and cross-platform, give less confidentiality and integrity support for e-government. Firstly, this paper analyzes four open source Web OSes on their application type, access control policies and their security problems. Then it abstracts the common security model of Web OSes. Secondly, based on this common security model, it constructs a LBACWeb (Lattice-based access control model for Web OS) model, which combining confidential label, integrity label and category set on the basis of lattice structure. Finally, it proposes the least privilege principle on trusted subjects and define a special privileged subject to enhance the flexibility and usability. The analysis and verification are given at last to elaborate the security and applicability of the LBACWeb model.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论的是电子政务中的Web操作系统安全模型，与AM生物医学材料方向完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about lattice-based access control for Web operating systems in e-government, with no mention of additive manufacturing, biomedical materials, porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 电子政务对信息系统安全需求高，现有Web OS安全支持不足。
summary_zh.method: 分析四种开源Web OS，抽象安全模型，构建LBACWeb模型。
summary_zh.result: 提出基于格结构的机密性、完整性标签和类别集的安全模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过分析和验证说明模型的安全性和适用性。

summary_en.motivation: E-government demands high security for information systems, but current Web OSes lack sufficient confidentiality and integrity support.
summary_en.method: Analyze four open-source Web OSes, abstract a common security model, and construct the LBACWeb model combining confidential and integrity labels with category sets on a lattice structure.
summary_en.result: The proposed model enhances security and usability by introducing a least privilege principle and a special privileged subject.
summary_en.validation: Security and applicability are demonstrated through analysis and verification.
